note: Seeded empty in round 0. A test is added here once it has a hypothesis with 2 pieces of evidence, a metric, a sample size and a read date.

fields.label: Test
fields.rule: CRO-<nn>, set when the test is written down

fields.label: Hypothesis
fields.rule: Because <evidence>, changing <element> on <page> for <device> will move <metric>

fields.label: Evidence
fields.rule: 2 or more pieces: a finding id, a brain record id, a review count

fields.label: Metric
fields.rule: one primary metric from session_funnel, for example add_to_cart_rate on mobile

fields.label: Smallest lift
fields.rule: the relative lift worth detecting, set before launch

fields.label: Sample per arm
fields.rule: 16 x p x (1 - p) / (p x mde) squared; 80 percent power, 5 percent two-sided

fields.label: Read date
fields.rule: launch + the days to reach the sample, and never under 14 days (2 full weeks)
